method: GP29 q13 arbitrary accepted-output deletion plus at most one arbitrary phase skip; necessary relaxation of <=1 strict adjacent-repeat retry
interpretation: No >=75%-visible embedding of the four source cribs survives even a relaxation that permits arbitrary deletions and one unconstrained phase skip. Any real q13 GP29 strict-repeat sender occurrence of these cribs at this visibility floor must therefore incur at least two rejected key draws before the m-th retained rune. This is conditional on the source cribs/q13 and does not constrain unrelated plaintext.
